check.title: Quick check
check.intro: Answer a few simple questions, one at a time. Not sure? Tap Not sure.
check.finalNote: Final decision is by the department.
check.q.stage.why: Different schemes are for different levels.
check.q.category.why: Some schemes are only for certain communities.
check.q.disability.why: Some schemes give extra help for disability.
check.q.incomeBand: About how much is your family's yearly income?
check.q.incomeBand.why: A rough range is enough. We never ask the exact amount.
check.q.asset: Does your family meet these asset rules?
check.q.asset.explanation: Family meets the asset conditions: land within limits; no government employee or pensioner; no four-wheeler (taxi, tractor, auto are fine); no income-tax payee
check.q.asset.why: Many schemes have land, vehicle and job limits.
check.q.children: How many children in your family study in Class 1 to 12?
check.q.children.why: Some schemes count children in the family.
check.q.girls: How many girls in your family are on Pragati, including you?
check.q.girls.why: Pragati allows at most 2 girls per family.
check.q.residence: Do you stay in a hostel or travel from home?
check.q.collegeType: What kind of college is it?
check.q.collegeType.why: Scheme rules depend on the college type.
check.q.admissionQuota: How did you get your seat?
check.q.class12Top20: Were you in the top 20% in Class XII?
check.opt.professional: Engineering, medical or other professional course
